author: More Perfect Union
description:
Indiana residents are paying $600, $700, $800 a month in electric bills.

Right now Indiana is being hit with some of the biggest rate increases in the U.S.

Data centers are driving up costs, BlackRock just bought one of the utilities, and people are demanding regulators step in.

Producer/Host: @uplandsandy
Editor: Joseph Howard
Coordinating Producer: Leah Abrams
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Their electric bills are twice their mortgage. Private equity wants to make it worse.
